generalAbilities.name: Feral Trackers
generalAbilities.description: A feral skull swarm gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to Seek and to Survival checks to Track, both against any creature that has taken damage from the swarm's Feral Gnaw within the previous 24 hours.

defensiveAbilities.name: Boneshard Burst
defensiveAbilities.description: When a feral skull swarm is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it erupts in an explosion of foul energy and bone fragments in a 30ft Burst, dealing 3d12 Piercing Damage|options:area-damage]{3d12 piercing damage and 2d12 void damage} (Basic DC 32 Reflex Saving Throw save).

defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Feral Gnaw
offensiveAbilities.description:
Each enemy in the swarm's space takes 2d6 Bludgeoning Damage,2d6[slashing]]{2d6 bludgeoning damage, 2d6 piercing damage, and 2d6 slashing damage} (Basic DC 32 Reflex Saving Throw save).

A creature that fails its saving throw also takes 1d10 Bleed Damage.

offensiveAbilities.name: Frightening Howl
offensiveAbilities.description:
The feral skull swarm emits a terrifying howl. Each creature within 60 feet must succeed at a DC 32 Will Saving Throw save or become Frightened 2 (Frightened 3 and Fleeing for 1 round on a critical failure).

Whether it succeeds or fails its save, a creature is temporarily immune to Frightening Howl for 24 hours.
